note: Rough first draft, not a source of truth. One access node per map area and one shelf per department (<department>:00); every shelf of a department routes to its area. A block open on several sides has its node in the middle, linked to every side; a route may start or end at an access node but never pass through one. Aisles are guessed from the gaps between the map's blocks, weights are straight-line metres at a placeholder scale, except an access link, which is the walk from the aisle to the block edge. Generated from areas.json and department-areas.json; see docs/plans/map.md §5.
